## TruChamber (the product)
- φ-split keyword shares + AES-256-GCM
- 3-hour black-box evaluation from first run (hard cut, no grace)
- Tamper-evident HMAC-signed license under ~/.chamber/
- After expiry or license edit the box hard-kills
- A purchased seat includes TRU8 (not a public dump)
- BSL-1.1 open source box (Change Date 2030-08-13 → Apache-2.0)
- Page: https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber

## Chamber Format v1 (interoperability)
- Sealed JSON object: v, algo, k_words, r_words, nonce, tag, ct
- algo = chamber-aes256gcm-phi · AAD = chamber-v1
- 2-of-2 φ-split · 64-word keyword encoding
- License / trial / unlock are out of scope of the format
- Suggested media type (informative): application/chamber+json

## TruChamber trial model
- 3 hours fully functional from first run on the machine
- After 3h (or license tamper) the box permanently shuts off
- Buy a seat (day / month / year) — includes TRU8

## TRU8 (compression tool)
- Public demos free with credit
- T_ZERO / T_DICT / T_TRISUM_HOT public tokens
- Production path comes with a TruChamber seat
- Suite (metered): free first 100 GB · then ~5¢/GB · /pps — not a seat

## TruGame (game engine — building)
- Officially on the lab project list (2026-08-13)
- Compression-aware asset pipeline (TRU8 residual path for smaller bundles)
- Chamber sealing for live / secure content
- Studio-facing; source private
- Related: TRU8 demos, Chamber, Great Agentic Olympiad
- Contact: mailto:corey@slidphilabs.com?subject=TruGame

## Wording
- TruChamber = the **product**. 3h black box, then a **seat** (day / month / year). Seat includes TRU8.
- TRU8 = compression tool. Demos free. Production path comes with the seat.
- Suite = **metered jobs** (100 GB then ~5¢/GB). Not a TruChamber seat.
- Historical ZRW / CDDG dollars do not buy TruChamber or TRU8.
- Access = entitlement claim. Not a codec dump.

## Scope
TruChamber seats include TRU8 (closed production path). Format = open wire shape. Residual engine never open-sourced. TruGame = game engine under active build (private source). Retired: $99 forever unlock, $1,900 second product, $90/mo inverted ladder.
